class.name: NNSTStateIsActiveGuard
class.brief_description: Checks if a given state is active.
class.description: This guard is used to check if the given [member state] is active. It returns [code]true[/code] if [member state] is empty or the resolved state is active, and [code]false[/code] if the state is inactive or the path does not resolve to an [NNSTTickedNodes] node (which also prints an error). It reports [constant NNSTRoot.STATE_CHANGE] from [method NNSTGuard.get_supported_trigger_types], because its result can change when another state becomes active or inactive.

members.member: The [NodePath] to the [NNSTTickedNodes] state to check, resolved relative to the [NNSTTransition] node evaluating this guard. If empty, the guard is satisfied and returns [code]true[/code]. If the path does not resolve to an [NNSTTickedNodes] node, an error is printed and the guard returns [code]false[/code].
